audit.whatIsWrong: Chart rows 0, 1, 5 and 6 disagree with the packet chart AND with the page's own whys[].
audit.why: Packet is Gwen, Gwen, Skill, Yasuo, Gwen, Yasuo, Gwen and the whys[] read exactly that way (whys[0] 'goes to Gwen', whys[1] 'stays Gwen', whys[5] 'is Yasuo's', whys[6] 'Gwen ... retake the matchup'), while win[]/phases[].side said Skill, Skill, ..., Gwen, Yasuo. The mirror also states the chart was realigned in both layers. Separately whys[3..5] name the wrong stages (Level 4 / Level 5 / Level 6 against rows Levels 4-5 / Level 6 / First item).
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 5, 6 flipped in both layers with ratings rescaled; whys[3..5] relabelled.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere despite 'trade around Hallowed Mist' being the whole plan.
audit.why: Snip Snip! 6.5/5.75/5/4.25/3.5, Hallowed Mist 22/21/20/19/18, Skip 'n Slash 13/12.5/12/11.5/11, Needlework 120/100/80, Wind Wall 25s at rank 1, Last Breath 70/50/30.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[2], early, mid, whys[4], phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist is described as a wall your dash cannot cross; Wind Wall's one real use is never stated; 'Last Breath converts ANY knockup'.
audit.why: Riot's text: the mist 'protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' It is a targeting restriction, not terrain — you can walk or dash into it, and doing so is the counterplay. Wind Wall blocks Needlework (the only projectile in her kit) and does nothing against the Snip Snip! cone, which the mirror confirms. Snip Snip!'s centre is true damage, so armour is not the answer. And Last Breath needs an airborne target that nothing in Gwen's kit provides — only your own two-stack Steel Tempest whirlwind.
audit.corrected: Mist reframed as a targeting bubble to step into; Wind Wall pointed at Needlework; true damage and the Q2 requirement stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is in the item block with no reason attached.
audit.why: A Thousand Cuts heals her off a portion of the bonus magic damage she deals to champions — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Written into spikes[3].text, late and breakdown.late.

edits.before: Your Q3 knock-up plus R punishes a Gwen who ults or Skips (E) aggressively outside her Mist; catch her the moment she steps out of the fog.

edits.before: Your crit all-in beats her if you get inside, but her W denies your Sweeping Blade and Wind Wall does nothing against her melee Q — time your dash for when Mist expires.
edits.after: Your crit all-in beats her inside the mist, and Wind Wall does nothing against her cone Q — but it deletes Needlework outright, so hold the 25s wall for her ultimate.

edits.before: Late Gwen scales hard with on-hit and her R execute; her Hallowed Mist makes her slippery, so you need a knock-up to pin her before she fogs out.
edits.after: Late Gwen scales on-hit and heals off A Thousand Cuts — Grievous Wounds before your second item is what makes the extended fight winnable.

edits.before: Gwen wins the opening levels — Snip Snip! (Q) shreds you in melee and Hallowed Mist (W) is a bubble your Sweeping Blade can't cross, so she farms and pokes safely. Concede the levels 1-2 pressure and avoid trading into her Mist.
edits.after: Gwen wins the opening levels — Snip Snip! (Q) shreds you in melee and its centre is true damage. Hallowed Mist (W) is 22s at rank 1 and only blocks targeting from outside, so step in or wait it out rather than poking at the edge.

edits.before: Level 3 is roughly even as your E mobility starts to matter, and Level 4 tips to you if you catch her outside the fog with Q3 into a trade. Level 5 swings back to Gwen once her Q scaling and W uptime let her out-DPS you again — patience over her Mist timers is everything.
edits.after: Level 3 is roughly even as your E mobility starts to matter, and 4-5 tip to you if you catch her outside the mist with a Q2 whirlwind. Level 6 swings back once her Q scaling and 22-second W uptime out-DPS you — patience over her Mist timers is everything.

edits.before: Level 6 favors you: Last Breath punishes any aggressive Skip or ult she throws outside Mist. But by 2+ items Gwen's on-hit scaling and R execute plus her fog make her slippery and dangerous — you must land a knock-up to pin her before she fogs out, or she wins the extended fight.
edits.after: First item favours you: Last Breath punishes any aggressive Skip 'n Slash outside the mist, and Wind Wall blanks Needlework. By two items Gwen's on-hit scaling and healing retake it — you need Grievous Wounds and your own Q2 knockup to pin her before she fogs out.

notes: Biggest correction: the page treated Hallowed Mist as terrain your dash cannot cross. Riot's text makes it a targeting restriction — entering the mist is the counterplay, and telling a paying player to wait 22 seconds instead is a lane-losing instruction. suspectNames flagged 'Snip Snip' in wants.foe[0]; the real error in that string was 'the Q dash' (her dash is Skip 'n Slash, E), which I fixed.
